description:
Split existing channel-file implementation into four independently reviewable PRs. Source: feat/channel-files at 814ca7a83b00356e8f1bd8e2155f159a371ae641; existing upstream PR https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/876; original feature tracker zaq-ic9.

Copy the existing implementation and consolidated tests from that exact source commit. Do not redesign or rewrite the feature. Copy scoped hunks, not whole files when that would overwrite newer upstream changes. Preserve authorization, delivery, alias, streaming, history and test contracts. Classify every source diff hunk; carry fixtures with their first consumer; move prerequisite hunks earlier when needed for standalone compilation. Final cumulative feature delta must match the source implementation, accounting explicitly for upstream changes.

Delivery: branches live on jat10/zaq. PR1 targets www-zaq-ai/zaq:main. PR2 targets PR1 branch on jat10/zaq; PR3 targets PR2; PR4 targets PR3. Open fork PRs when their implementations are concrete and validated. Once PR1 merges upstream, restack PR2 on updated upstream/main, preserving only its incremental changes, and create its upstream PR. Repeat for PR3 then PR4. At most one replacement upstream PR open at a time. Do not merge automatically. Keep #876 as a source/reference until the replacement is ready; do not close it automatically.

Initial worktree baseline: upstream/main at 7acdadc6d72c637406ca8e651c1a434bcb92c371. Later worktrees are reserved now and must be restacked on their predecessor's implemented tip before copying their slice. Empty branches are not implemented PRs.

Action reuse assessment: this task creates tracking/worktrees only; no executable operations change. During extraction reuse the source Actions and boundaries verbatim, inspect their current upstream owners, and record any unavoidable adaptation before editing. No new parallel operation APIs.

Validation: each slice follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, with mix q, scoped tests, self-review, post-review coverage handoff and final mix precommit. Existing tests retain assertions. Reuse existing feature E2E and zaq-ic9 approval tracking; new or substantially rewritten feature E2E requires the existing human UX approval gate. No new E2E is needed for tracking/worktree creation.

Sequence: PR1 -> PR2 -> PR3 -> PR4. Child closure means upstream merged, not merely implementation finished. Fork stack implementation may proceed using the completed predecessor tip while upstream review is pending.
title: [zaq-rn4] Split channel files into four sequential upstream PRs
